headline: Bitcoin Long-Short Ratio Rises 0.17 To 2.51 As Price Falls 1.37528 Percent To 77k
narrative: Bitcoin's long-short ratio rose 0.17 over 24 hours to 2.51, the 92.9th percentile of its 30-day range, a crowded-long pipe that means leverage is stacked on the long side. The coin fell 1.37528 percent to 77k, so that crowded long position is sitting under a lower spot price, while Solana's ratio rose 0.11 to 3.54, the 98.6th percentile, the same crowded-long pipe in a second major. Options skew printed 19.19, downside heavily bid into the Nov. 3 expiry, with puts struck at 69k and calls at 85k, the hedge pipe showing institutional hedging under the same decline.
author: jordan
